QuestInfo.name: A Piece of Will
QuestInfo.1: When I asked #p2060100# to give back the human's will power, she said she threw it away in the crack of a dimension. She said if I want it back, go to #b#m923000000##k and get it myself. She says #m923000000# can be opened by #b#t4000175##k as many times as I want...As long as I have #t4000175#, she said she would open the dimension.  All right, well, let's get #t4000175# first then. \r\n#i4031472##t4031472# #b#c4031472#/40#k
QuestInfo.2: #p2060100# said that the separated will power can't be simply absorbed back.

0.0: Didn't you hear that #p2060100# doesn't like humans? I'll kick you off if you are a lost traveler. What are you doing here? What do you want?\r\n#b#L0#I want my strong will back.#l
0.1: Will.. How did you get to know about it? Give you your will....I'll give it to you in honor of your coming here to see me. I don't wanna fight with you. \r\n#b#L0# Do you mean you're gonna give my Strong Will back??.#l
0.2: I can't just give it out. I imprisoned most of the Will inside the cracked dimension. You can open the dimension and bring the pieces of will. But it's hard. Do you want to do it?

yes.0: Then I'll open the dimension. Get me a miniature Pianus. That's the key to open the dimension. Open the dimension, and get 40 Pieces of Courage. Ah, once you have a miniature Pianus, you can open the dimension with it, however every time you want to enter the dimension, you will need a miniature Pianus. Sadly, the miniature version only works once per trip for 5 minutes. But that's only for 5 minutes, which means you can go in there with as many friends as possible, but only for 5 minutes per trip.
yes.1: I'm a witch. I shouldn't be nice to you. Now you can get out!

no.0: If you don't want it, fine. Your Will shall remain in the dimension.

1.0: You're pretty good to get 40 #t4031472#, but this is not the end. The will, when separated from the human host, can't be absorbed so soon.

item.0: Haven't you got #t04031472#? You're not as great as I thought. I heard you completed the 4th Job advancement...
